daily.today_energy: Saturn retrograde in Aries is asking you to revisit some boundaries you've been too rigid about. Meanwhile, Mars conjunct Jupiter is pushing everyone's energy up, but your steady Capricorn nature knows how to channel this without overcommitting.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter brings warmth to your connections today. If you're coupled up, there's real ease in conversation. Single? Someone might actually see the depth you usually keep hidden. Don't play it too cool.
daily.career: The Sun squaring Mars and Jupiter means ambitious energy is everywhere, but it's chaotic. Your Saturn influence keeps you focused on what actually matters. This is your day to let others scatter while you make real progress on one solid goal.
daily.health: With all this fire element energy, your usually grounded nature might feel restless. Channel it through movement—a solid workout or long walk beats sitting with the buzz. Keep your routine steady; it's your anchor today.

weekly.overview: This week hits different for you, Cap. The Full Moon in Gemini (late week) illuminates communication and mental clarity, while Mars-Jupiter conjunction in Leo fires up your creativity sector. Best Day: Thursday. Watch-Out Day: Tuesday, when Sun squares Mars—tension's real but manageable. Navigate with intention.
weekly.love: Venus in Libra keeps things balanced and fair, so if you've been holding back a conversation, this is your window. The Full Moon late week brings emotional transparency that's actually refreshing. Single? Someone might finally get the hint you're worth the effort.
weekly.career: Sun-Jupiter square early week creates pressure to prove yourself, but don't overcommit. By midweek, Mercury in Scorpio helps you dig into strategic details others miss. Your competitive edge sharpens as Mars-Jupiter conjunction fuels ambition. This is your moment to propose that idea.
weekly.health: Energy fluctuates as the Moon moves through Pisces early on—rest if you need it. By midweek, Mars-Jupiter conjunction in Leo motivates you to actually hit the gym or start that routine. Physical movement becomes genuinely appealing, not a chore.
